Both-actor speed/Offering/permission/Reclaim/X matrices cover actor and route legality. Browser covers actual route/cancel/reload/debits/Offering/permission and normal AI response.
- Energy: `refreshes $side first=$first extra=$extra exactly once`, `keeps the standalone refill for $side current=$current copies=$copies`, `reads start-of-turn changes before the refresh for %s`, and `removes carry when its physical source loses its static ability` cover first/later/extra boundaries, copies and changing sources. No new prompt, asynchronous request, external failure path, state field or concurrent-writer API is introduced; the ordinary serialized fold and existing energy transport apply. Browser proves later own-turn retention13/10 both sides; it does not exercise Dreamwell-card additions.
- Dawn: `rolls back new admission/progress/reaction writes when the same resolving step fails` covers partial writes/error; `reloads a queued reaction after its physical source departs...` covers source capture/save/load/determinize/resolve; `validates optional lower progress and strict special-kind tuples on saved states` covers malformed/legacy state. Batch/opponent/forced/either/floating/eligibility/source lifecycle cases cover shared count and actor boundaries. No new concurrently mutating actor or I/O API; intents are serialized by the fold.
- Privacy: two owner cases of `records the threshold seen in a private prompt's display for %s` and two owner cases of `retains a privately observed committed reaction after its Foresee continuation fails for %s` prove public pass->private prompt->legal answer->error. Own view floor, opponent privacy, saved view, determinized view/known floor and original input hashes after sampling are asserted.
